appInfo.title: Shopee 8.8 Ưu Đãi Nửa Giá
appInfo.description:
Don't miss out on amazing deals at Shopee's 8.8 Super Sale - Half Price - Super Fast, Super Cheap!
Xtra Vouchers up to 50% off
Free Shipping (*)
From July 26th to August 10th
(*) Program details (including exclusions) can be found on the Free Shipping page in the Shopee app.

Welcome to SHOPEE - your destination for all your online shopping and entertainment needs.

FAST ONLINE SHOPPING ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
● Enjoy super savings on online shopping both domestically and internationally with hot deals. Besides consumer goods, fashion, and cosmetics, you can buy service vouchers and top up your phone credit.

● Choose ShopeeFood service in the Shopee app to order food for delivery. ShopeeFood takes care of your daily meals or simply satisfies your cravings with delicious food anytime, anywhere.
● Shop with confidence from reputable shops. Shopee Mall guarantees 100% authentic products.
● Enjoy online shopping and shipping anywhere in Vietnam. Shopee partners with reputable shipping companies such as SPX, GHN, GHTK, etc.

ENJOY EXCLUSIVE PROMOTIONS AND FAST NATIONWIDE DELIVERY
● Create a Shopee account for free, usable for both online shopping and selling.
● Get a 0 VND discount on your first Shopee purchase.
● Participate in Shopee Games and win millions of Shopee Coins. 01 Shopee Coin will be refunded 1 VND when shopping at Shopee
● Join Book Club, Beauty Club, Home Club to receive exclusive offers on many consumer products, fashion, and cosmetics
● Save money online during major promotional days such as 6.6, 10.10, 11.11, 12.12, the 15th of the Month (Mid-Month and End-of-Month Payday).

EXPERIENCE THE CONVENIENCE OF BUY NOW, PAY LATER
● Receive your goods first, pay after one month or pay in installments for up to 6 months with SPayLater! Approved in minutes and enjoy shopping for large orders such as tools and equipment with flexible installment payments.
● Tien Phong Commercial Joint Stock Bank - TPBank is the credit service provider for SPayLater on the Shopee platform.
● Flexible payment terms from 75 days to 180 days.
● Maximum effective interest rate of 58%.
● For example, if you buy an item worth VND 1,000,000 and choose to pay within 6 months with SPayLater, you will pay VND 196,167 each month for the first 5 months and VND 196,165 for the last month. The total is VND 1,177,000, including VND 1,000,000 principal and VND 177,000 interest (with an effective interest rate of 58%/year).

EASY CASH LOAN OPPORTUNITY FOR SELLERS
● We offer digital lending services in partnership with local banks. Get approved and withdraw your loan in minutes with SEasy Seller Loans
● SEasy Seller Loans is a lending service for Sellers on Shopee, provided by reputable Credit Institution partners through the Shopee e-commerce platform
● Flexible repayment terms from 75 to 180 days
● Maximum effective interest rate of 35%
● For example, if you withdraw VND 10,000,000 and choose to repay within 3 months, you will have to pay VND 3,529,641 per month for the first two months and VND 3,548,245 for the last month. A total of 10,607,527 VND, including 10,000,000 VND principal and 607,527 VND interest (with an effective interest rate of 35% per year).

HOW IS SHOPPING ON THE SHOPEE APP DIFFERENT FROM THE SHOPEE WEBSITE?

● Receive amazing gifts as a new Shopee customer
● Receive notifications about hot deals and daily promotions
● Watch shops livestreaming via Shopee Live
● Participate in exciting Shopee games
● Order food for fast and easy delivery with a variety of offers using the ShopeeFood service available on the Shopee shopping app.

--- Experience online shopping with ease!

SHOPEE is the leading online shopping site in Vietnam in terms of traffic. Shopee also operates in other countries such as Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Philippines, Taiwan, Brazil, Mexico & Colombia.

Address: Floors 4-5-6, Capital Place Building, 29 Lieu Giai Street, Ngoc Khanh Ward, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi City, Vietnam.

*Shopee Vietnam Website: www.shopee.vn
*Shopee on Facebook: facebook.com/ShopeeVN
*Shopee on Instagram: @shopee_vn
*Shopee on TikTok: @shopee_vn
*24/7 Hotline for advice and support: 19001221
